title: Closed support adjunction and its derived counit
statement:
Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]), let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $A$ be a finite ring, not necessarily commutative. Work in the left module sheaf categories on the small pro-etale sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use their ordinary unbounded derived categories and localization functors $Q_S$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define $F(N)=\ker(N\to j_*j^*N)$ and $H(N)=i^*F(N)$ with the coefficient actions and units of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact].

Assume $i_*$ is exact and fully faithful. Assume also that $j^*$ is restriction, that $j^*i_*M=0$ for every left $A_Z$-module sheaf $M$, and that the closed unit $N\to i_*i^*N$ is an isomorphism for every left $A_T$-module sheaf $N$ with $j^*N=0$.

Then $i_*$ is left adjoint to $H$. Its sheaf counit $i_*H(N)\to N$ is the inverse of the supported unit $F(N)\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*i^*F(N)$ followed by the kernel inclusion. Let $RH$ be the total right derived functor of $H$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived]. For every K-injective complex $I$ (every map from an acyclic complex to $I$ is homotopic to zero [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]), the complex $H(I)$ is K-injective and $RH(Q_TI)=Q_ZH(I)$. Termwise $i_*$ induces a functor $i_*^D$ on the unbounded derived categories; one has $i_*^D\dashv RH$, and its counit at $Q_TI$ is $Q_T(i_*H(I)\to I)$ with the just specified termwise kernel inclusion. In particular $Q_Ti_*H(I)=i_*^D RH(Q_TI)$ under the canonical derived-functor comparisons.
